result.citation: S.F. Admin. Code § 37.9A(e) (as amended through Ord. No. 03-26)
result.citation_basis: § 37.9A(e), incl. (e)(1)(C), (e)(1)(D) and (e)(2): O040; Ord. No. 03-26 (2/8/26, amending § 37.9A): O040 'Recent Changes to the Ordinance' table
result.note: Kept the lawyer's pinpoint § 37.9A(e), which O040 confirms holds the Ellis Act relocation amounts, the elderly/disabled supplement and the annual CPI adjustment; I added 'as amended through Ord. No. 03-26' because O040's amendment table lists that ordinance (2/8/26) as changing § 37.9A, and I dropped the 'Rent Ordinance Section 37.9A' label as a nickname; the card's quote stays from the supplied corpus (D083, a Rent Board rate page that, like D082, is not the law's text), and no document is quoted as official because O040, though City-published, states it is not an official record and names American Legal as the official publisher.
